notes.title: Update v1.04 released !!
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Add [b]"back to checkpoint"[/b] option in pause menu. 
[*]Add  [b]"invert vertical/horizontal look"[/b] in option menu.
[*]Optimize smoother character movements.
[*]Optimize the dodge. 
[*]Remove jumping start animation and recovery time when landing.

[/list]

O_O"

notes.title: Recent adjustment post and Update v1.03 released !!
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Optimize model texture.
[*]Optimize the drop frames on [b]Mission 0 & 2[/b].
[*]Change the position of some objects, in oder to let the gameplay more  smoothly.
[*]Greer's Hurt-Animation is faster.
[*]Add [b]a new camera change of locking on enemys[/b] when you stick to the wall in [b]Mission 1 & 2[/b]. But you can still change back to the old one in the setting.
[/list]

The current game performance optimization will be to come to an end. Then will begin to adjust character control related issues. And... you can try choose a lower screen resolution ( 1600x900, 1280x720 ) or quality setting when fps is too low! ( Temporarily solve this problem )

Thanks.

notes.title: Yee. Hello everyone!
notes.content:
This game was produced by our team members in our college years.
( 2016 ) ( we've all graduated now. )

We still have many ideas, story lines, and plots, lack of time and resources kept us from including them all in this game. However, we will continue to do our best in the world of game developing.

Thank you so much for trying out our game, and we hope that you will continue to support us in the future. (´･ω･`)
